decide.command: cd /data/scfix-o4 && nice -n 10 taskset -c 21-31 /data/trebuchet-clean/FastDyn/scopt-env/bin/python -B driver/decide.py packet/timing-A uart/timing-A cli/timing-A packet/timing-A2 uart/timing-A2 cli/timing-A2 packet/timing-H uart/timing-H cli/timing-H --gates gates/all.json --screen screen.json --out p5/P5.decide.json

conventions: d = Hodges-Lehmann of block log-ratios log(sqrt(T(o4) T(o4-aa)) / T(arm)), burn-in block 0 dropped; positive = faster than O4-r1. SE = block-bootstrap SD (20,000). lb95/ub95 one-sided 95% (Student t, df n_w - 1; pooled: inverse-variance, Welch df). p one-sided for 'faster than O4'. lb_gt_log098: LB95_w > log 0.98 (-2.02%).

o4_pwhopr.what_makes_it_faster: Its firmware region selection. o4_pwhopr is O4-r1 with exactly one change: the firmware-inline params are {mode exhaustive, cost_model profile, phase steady, trust user, interrupts disabled, icount ignored, planner whopr, partitions 4, workers 4, member_slot_skip on} (design/pipelines/o4-pwhopr.toml) instead of hot-loop {min_call_count 1000, cost model auto with the nested profit gate}. Priced exhaustive selection considers every discovered call, not only hot-loop roots with >= 1000 calls, and admits a root when the steady profile prices its whole recursive region as profitable. On cli, where the gain is shown, its 14 roots are o4_min2's 13 plus 0x2daa (20 members); it refuses o4's root 0x83d06 (279 members) as not_profitable, and every region is entered once per run (cli VERIFY.md). uart: 27 regions (o4's 19 plus o4_min2's 7 plus 0x819c6). packet: 53 regions (+10 / -5 roots against o4), entered through lookup about 3,100 times per run against 52-55 for o4
o4_pwhopr.how: replace firmware-inline's params in O4-r1 with o4-pwhopr.toml's (the measured arm's exact delta); with I1, add isb_boundary = true, which firmware-inline applies in exhaustive mode; X1 and X4 remove other passes, and firmware-inline still runs after the B3 passes
o4_pwhopr.build_evidence: o4_pwhopr itself passed G0 on all three workloads (gates/all.json); O4-r2 (o4r2) passes G0 and validity on all three (below)

composition.name: O4-r2
changes_vs_r1: A5 absorbed: firmware-inline params = o4-pwhopr.toml's (mode exhaustive, cost_model profile; min_call_count dropped)
X1: host-inline pass removed, INLINE_CALL dropped from allowed_capabilities (no --pgo-launch, no gdb-counted helper replay)
X4: specialize-returns, constant-propagation, branch-folding, dead-host-ops removed
kept: firmware-inline trusted regions with member_slot_skip on, planner whopr
composition.b1_note: decide.py's registered composition (composition_registered) does not know about the absorption: it lists I1, X1 and X4 only, with contains_addon false, so `make_plan.py B1 --decision p5/P5.decide.json` would carry that x_composition and decide.py would apply the REMOVE rule to B1. O4-r2 also carries A5, which is in O4-r2 only because it was shown faster; confirming that claim is the ADD-confirm rule (pooled LB > 0, LB_w > log 0.98). Which rule B1 uses, and how the x_composition is written, is for the B1 step to settle before its plan is made
composition.b2_note: B2 arms per 3.8: o4r2, o4r2-aa, o4, c7b3, s6b3, p7, fl3, the accepted single-item arms (o4_isb, o4_nohi, o4_nospec, and o4_pwhopr as the absorbed item), and the rejected candidate with the highest pooled d, o4_rank (decide.py: b2_rejected_with_highest_d). O4-r2 changes firmware-inline and host-inline, so H is rerun with o4r2 as the reference
composition.adoption: O4.toml and -O4 move to O4-r2 only if B1 and B2 pass (3.8); until then O4 stays at r1
composition.build_pipeline_note: arm o4r2 was built with --pipeline design/pipelines/o4r2.toml, O4-r2.toml with only name ('o4r2') and description changed (tomllib and scopt load_pipeline: to_json differs only in those two keys). Building with --pipeline O4-r2.toml itself fails in scopt's O4 preflight: "pipeline 'O4-r2' is not the packaged /data/fastdyn-work/fd-int/tools/scopt/pipelines/O4-r2.toml; O4 is fixed: copy O4-rN.toml under another name to experiment" (rc 2, before any pass; attempt kept in p5/failed/). The name does not reach cache.sc: O4-r1 via -O4 equals c7b3 (sealed-pgo-7-b3) byte for byte
